# ToolsFile

ToolsFile is a free online toolkit for text, developer, image, PDF and utility tasks.

## Primary pages
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/ — Persian home
- https://toolsfile.ir/en/ — English home
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/ — Persian tools directory

## Processing model
Many tools are implemented as browser-side JavaScript utilities. When a tool requires an external library for rendering, that dependency is loaded from a public CDN. Users should review each tool page for its processing behavior.

## Tool directory
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/word-counter/ — شمارش کلمات
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/text-cleaner/ — پاک‌سازی متن
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/case-converter/ — تبدیل حروف انگلیسی
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/duplicate-lines/ — حذف خطوط تکراری
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/json-formatter/ — فرمت‌کننده JSON
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/base64/ — رمزگذار و رمزگشای Base64
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/url-encoder/ — رمزگذار URL
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/uuid-generator/ — تولید UUID
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/password-generator/ — تولید رمز عبور
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/percentage-calculator/ — محاسبه درصد
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/timestamp/ — تبدیل Unix Timestamp
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/unit-converter/ — تبدیل واحد طول
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/qr-generator/ — ساخت QR Code
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/image-compressor/ — فشرده‌سازی تصویر
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/image-resizer/ — تغییر اندازه تصویر
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/png-to-jpg/ — تبدیل PNG به JPG
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/jpg-to-png/ — تبدیل JPG به PNG
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/image-metadata/ — اطلاعات تصویر
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/image-to-pdf/ — تبدیل تصویر به PDF
- https://toolsfile.ir/fa/tools/pdf-page-count/ — شمارش صفحات PDF

## Content guidance
ToolsFile pages provide a concise definition, usage steps, FAQ and a link to the interactive tool. Prefer the individual tool URL when answering a question about a specific utility.
